entities.name: NADH-quinone oxidoreductase subunit C/D
observations: 597 aa bacterial NuoC/NuoD fusion protein; exact sequence hash match to reviewed UniProt Q8K9Y5.
N-terminal region corresponds to NuoC (approximately residues 1–187); C-terminal region corresponds to NuoD (approximately residues 211–597).
Pfam domains: Complex1_30kDa PF00329.26 at residues 47–175 and Complex1_49kDa PF00346.25 at residues 326–597.
Acts as part of respiratory complex I (NDH-1), whose peripheral arm transfers electrons from NADH through FMN and Fe-S centers to quinone and couples this to proton translocation.
Annotated as a peripheral membrane protein on the cytoplasmic side of the inner membrane.
Sequence-derived properties: molecular mass 69,342 Da, pI 6.22, GRAVY -0.255, predicted charge at pH 7 of -6.0.

entities.name: Respiratory electron transport chain
observations: NuoCD participates in bacterial complex I (NDH-1)-mediated respiratory electron transport.
Reference annotation describes transfer of electrons from NADH to quinone and conservation of energy by proton-gradient formation.

entities.name: RHEA:57888
observations: Overall complex I reaction: quinone + NADH + 5 H+(in) = quinol + NAD+ + 4 H+(out).
This is the reaction of the multisubunit NDH-1 complex; the NuoCD fusion is a structural/peripheral-arm component rather than an independently acting complete enzyme.

entities.name: Q8K9Y5
observations: Reviewed UniProt reference from Buchnera aphidicola subsp. Schizaphis graminum; 100% identity and 100% coverage to the query; exact sequence hash match.
Annotated as NADH-quinone oxidoreductase subunit C/D.
